title: Juneau, AK — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Juneau, AK: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Juneau is a city in AK with a population of 32,000. Alaska’s capital city nestled between mountains and sea, with no road access and stunning scenery. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher.
